papers.title: Effect of immunonutrition on postoperative infectious complications and survival after colon cancer surgery: long-term follow up of randomized clinical trial
papers.authors: Lee J, Park H, Lee S, Kim C, Kim H
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: A previous randomized clinical trial (RCT) in patients undergoing elective colon cancer surgery showed that preoperative immunonutrition did not reduce short-term postoperative infectious complications. This study reports the long-term follow-up of that RCT, evaluating the impact of preoperative immunonutrition and the association of postoperative infectious complications with survival outcomes.
METHODS: This secondary analysis used prospectively collected survival data from a prior RCT in which patients were randomized 1:1 to receive either preoperative immunonutrition plus a normal diet or a normal diet alone (control) for 7 days before surgery. The primary endpoints were disease-free survival (DFS) and overall survival (OS). Survival outcomes were analysed in relation to randomized treatment allocation and clinicopathological variables, including postoperative complications, using Kaplan-Meier methods and Cox proportional hazards models.
RESULTS: A total of 161 patients were included, with 79 randomized to immunonutrition and 82 to control. The mean age was 65.3 years, and 65.8% were male, with similar baseline characteristics between groups. After a median follow-up of 57 months (range 4-65), preoperative immunonutrition did not affect 5-year DFS (80% versus 86% in controls; P = 0.474) or 5-year OS (88% versus 90%; P = 0.761). In contrast, postoperative infectious complications were associated with lower 5-year OS (74% versus 92%; P = 0.013) and showed a trend towards worse DFS (71% versus 86%; P = 0.065). On multivariable analysis, advanced T category and postoperative infectious complications remained independently associated with poorer DFS (HR 2.53; P = 0.041) and OS (HR 4.14; P = 0.007). The adverse prognostic effect of infectious complications was evident primarily in patients with advanced T category disease.
CONCLUSION: Preoperative immunonutrition did not improve long-term survival after colon cancer surgery. Postoperative infectious complications were independently associated with worse long-term outcomes, providing prospective evidence that supports previous observational findings.

papers.title_zh: 免疫營養對大腸癌手術後感染併發症及存活之影響：一項隨機臨床試驗的長期追蹤結果
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：先前一項針對接受擇期大腸癌手術病人的隨機臨床試驗（RCT）顯示，術前免疫營養並未降低短期術後感染併發症。本研究報告該RCT的長期追蹤結果，評估術前免疫營養的長期影響，以及術後感染併發症與存活結果的關聯。方法：本次為次級分析，使用先前RCT前瞻性收集的存活資料，病人以1:1隨機分配接受術前免疫營養加正常飲食，或單純正常飲食（對照組），為期手術前7天。主要終點為疾病無存活期（DFS）與總存活期（OS）。以Kaplan-Meier法與Cox比例風險模型分析存活結果與隨機分組及臨床病理變項（包括術後併發症）之關聯。結果：共納入161名病人，79人隨機分配至免疫營養組，82人分配至對照組。平均年齡65.3歲，65.8%為男性，兩組基準特徵相似。中位追蹤57個月（範圍4-65個月）後，術前免疫營養對5年DFS無影響（80% vs 對照組86%；P=0.474），對5年OS亦無影響（88% vs 90%；P=0.761）。相對地，術後感染併發症與較低的5年OS相關（74% vs 92%；P=0.013），且DFS呈現變差趨勢（71% vs 86%；P=0.065）。多變量分析顯示，較晚期T分期與術後感染併發症仍獨立與較差的DFS（HR 2.53；P=0.041）及OS（HR 4.14；P=0.007）相關。感染併發症的不良預後效應主要見於T分期較晚期的病人。結論：術前免疫營養並未改善大腸癌手術後的長期存活。術後感染併發症獨立與較差的長期預後相關，此結果提供前瞻性證據，支持先前觀察性研究的發現。

papers.title: Indocyanine green fluorescence angiography for prevention of anastomotic leak in colorectal surgery: a graded systematic review and meta-analysis with trial sequential analysis of randomized controlled trials
papers.authors: Albashier M, Al Sayed M, Altabbaa H, Hih N, Maged M, Lebda N
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Anastomotic leak (AL) is a major driver of morbidity after colorectal resection. Indocyanine-green fluorescence angiography (ICG-FA) provides real-time intraoperative perfusion assessment, but its impact across randomized trials remains debated. This review aims to evaluate the efficacy and safety of ICG-FA compared with conventional intraoperative assessment in preventing AL in colorectal surgery.
METHODS: A systematic review and a meta-analysis was conducted in accordance with the PRISMA guidelines, including RCTs comparing ICG-FA with conventional assessment. The primary outcome was overall AL; secondary outcomes included leak grade, anatomic location, operative metrics, and change in surgical plan (CISP). Pooled risk ratios (RR) or mean differences (MD) with 95% confidence intervals (CI) were calculated using random- or fixed-effects models. Trial sequential analysis (TSA) was used to evaluate evidence sufficiency.
RESULTS: Eight RCTs (n = 4712) met the inclusion criteria. ICG-FA reduced overall AL versus control (risk ratio [RR] 0.68, 95% CI 0.58-0.81; I2 = 0%). The absolute risk reduction was 3.6%, yielding a number needed to treat of around 24 to prevent one leak. TSA crossed the superiority boundary for the primary endpoint, indicating sufficient evidence of the assumed control risk and effect size. Benefits were more apparent for left-sided anastomoses and for lower-grade leaks (A and A + B), whereas severe (Grade C) leaks and reoperation did not differ significantly. Overall complications showed a small relative reduction, but TSA indicated insufficient information size. Other safety outcomes (surgical site infection, ileus, mortality) were similar between groups.
CONCLUSIONS: High-certainty evidence demonstrates that ICG-FA reduces overall and low-grade AL, principally in left-sided resections, without prolonging operative time. ICG-FA should be considered an evidence-based adjunct to optimize perfusion assessment in colorectal surgery.
REGISTRATION: PROSPERO CRD420251139372.

papers.title_zh: 吲哚青綠螢光血管造影（ICG-FA）預防大腸直腸手術吻合口洩漏：隨機對照試驗之分級系統性回顧、統合分析與試驗序列分析
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：吻合口洩漏（AL）是大腸直腸切除術後病態發生率的主要原因。吲哚青綠螢光血管造影（ICG-FA）提供術中即時灌流評估，但其在隨機試驗中的效果仍有爭議。本回顧旨在評估ICG-FA與傳統術中評估相比，於預防大腸直腸手術吻合口洩漏的效果與安全性。方法：依循PRISMA指引進行系統性回顧與統合分析，納入比較ICG-FA與傳統評估的RCT。主要結果為整體吻合口洩漏；次要結果包括洩漏分級、解剖位置、手術指標及手術計畫變更（CISP）。使用隨機或固定效應模型計算合併風險比（RR）或平均差（MD）及95%信賴區間。以試驗序列分析（TSA）評估證據充足性。結果：8篇RCT（n=4712）符合納入條件。ICG-FA相較對照組降低整體吻合口洩漏（RR 0.68，95% CI 0.58-0.81；I²=0%）。絕對風險降低為3.6%，換算需治療人數（NNT）約為24以預防一例洩漏。TSA顯示主要終點已跨越優越性邊界，代表就假設對照組風險與效果量而言證據已充足。左側吻合及低分級洩漏（A級及A+B級）獲益較明顯，而嚴重（C級）洩漏及再手術率則無顯著差異。整體併發症呈現小幅相對降低，但TSA顯示資訊量仍不足。其他安全性結果（手術部位感染、腸阻塞、死亡率）兩組相似。結論：高確定性證據顯示ICG-FA可降低整體及低分級吻合口洩漏，主要見於左側切除術，且不延長手術時間。ICG-FA應被視為大腸直腸手術中優化灌流評估的實證輔助工具。註冊：PROSPERO CRD420251139372。

papers.title: COVID-19 AND IBD: LOOK BEYOND THE VIRUS. A SYSTEMATIC REVIEW AND META-ANALYSIS FOCUSED ON BIOLOGIC THERAPY CONTINUITY
papers.authors: Rolim M, Leite A, Perdigão Neto L, Levin A
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND/OBJECTIVE: Whether COVID-19 worsens the longterm course of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) remains uncertain. We synthesized comparative cohorts to assess IBD outcomes after SARS-CoV-2 infection versus noninfected IBD controls and to evaluate the impact of biologic discontinuation.
METHODS: Systematic review (PRISMA 2020). Adult IBD cohorts with vs without prior SARS-CoV-2. Databases: MEDLINE (PubMed), Web of Science, and Scopus; reference lists screened. Time window: Jan 2020 to Dec 2024. Risk of bias: Newcastle-Ottawa. Randomeffects Mantel-Haenszel with REML variance and Hartung-Knapp adjustment; heterogeneity by I2/τ2/Q. Zero events handled via 0.5 continuity correction; sensitivity analyses reported risk differences (percentage points) and studylevel effects for sparse outcomes. Certainty graded with GRADE.
RESULTS: Four matched cohorts (n≈1.3k; Italy/USA). Prior SARS-CoV-2 did not worsen IBD clinical course (OR: 1.06; 95%CI: 0.76-1.49), nor alter UC extent (OR: 1.26; 95%CI: 0.33-4.83) or CD location/behavior (OR: 1.00; 95%CI: 0.06-16.15 / OR: 1.00; 95%CI: 0.46-2.18). Conversely, COVID-19 associated with biologic delay/discontinuation (OR: 10.44; 95%CI: 3.56-30.62). Across studies, flares were more frequent when biologics were delayed/stopped (~52% vs ~18%; RD ≈ +34 p.p.).
CONCLUSION: COVID-19 per se does not appear to aggravate IBD outcomes; the clinically actionable signal is treatment continuity. In IBD patients without highrisk features for severe COVID-19, maintaining biologics should be considered to prevent flares.
papers.title_zh: COVID-19與發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）：超越病毒本身——聚焦生物製劑治療延續性之系統性回顧與統合分析
papers.abstract_zh: 背景/目的：COVID-19是否會惡化發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）的長期病程仍不確定。我們整合比較性世代研究，評估感染SARS-CoV-2後之IBD病人結局，並與未感染之IBD對照組比較，同時評估生物製劑停用之影響。方法：系統性回顧（依PRISMA 2020），納入成人IBD世代研究，比較曾感染與未感染SARS-CoV-2者。資料庫包括MEDLINE（PubMed）、Web of Science及Scopus，並篩選參考文獻列表。時間範圍為2020年1月至2024年12月。偏誤風險評估採用Newcastle-Ottawa量表。統計方法採隨機效應Mantel-Haenszel模型，以REML估計變異數並進行Hartung-Knapp校正；異質性以I2/τ2/Q評估。零事件以0.5連續性校正處理；敏感性分析報告風險差異（百分點）及稀疏結果之研究層級效應。證據等級以GRADE評定。結果：共納入四個配對世代研究（n約1300人；義大利/美國）。曾感染SARS-CoV-2並未惡化IBD臨床病程（OR: 1.06；95%CI: 0.76-1.49），亦未改變潰瘍性結腸炎（UC）之病灶範圍（OR: 1.26；95%CI: 0.33-4.83）或克隆氏症（CD）之病灶位置/行為（OR: 1.00；95%CI: 0.06-16.15／OR: 1.00；95%CI: 0.46-2.18）。相反地，COVID-19與生物製劑延遲/停用有關（OR: 10.44；95%CI: 3.56-30.62）。各研究顯示，當生物製劑被延遲或停用時，發作（flare）更為常見（約52% vs 18%；風險差異約+34個百分點）。結論：COVID-19本身似乎不會惡化IBD結局；具臨床可行動意義的訊號是治療延續性。對於無重症COVID-19高風險因子之IBD病人，應考慮維持生物製劑治療以預防疾病發作。

papers.relevance_why: 議題聚焦IBD內科生物製劑管理，非直接手術決策，但影響大腸直腸外科合併照護之IBD病人（尤其術前術後）。

papers.title: REGIONAL AND MULTIFACTORIAL PATTERNS OF INFLAMMATORY BOWEL DISEASE IN BRAZIL: A SYSTEMATIC ANALYSIS OF HOT SPOTS IN WESTERN SÃO PAULO AND PARANÁ
papers.authors: Quaresma A, Teixeira F, Valverde D, Hino A, Damião A, Kotze P
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD) is a complex condition influenced by interactions among genetic, environmental, immunological, and behavioral factors. The global rise in IBD, particularly in rapidly urbanizing countries like Brazil, reflects environmental transitions' impact on disease patterns. Regional disparities in diagnostic coverage and environmental factors highlight IBD "hot spots", particularly in Western São Paulo and Northwestern Paraná, which share similar socio-economic and environmental characteristics. This study systematically reviews these epidemiological patterns to address gaps and support public health policies.
METHODS: A systematic literature review adhering to PRISMA guidelines was conducted to assess Brazilian IBD epidemiology from 2006 to 2026. Data sources included PubMed, SciELO, and LILACS, with Boolean search strategies incorporating controlled vocabulary and free-text terms. Eligible studies provided primary epidemiological data on IBD incidence, prevalence, and associated risk factors. Hot spots were identified through geospatial analysis using Moran's I index, supported by integrative conceptual models like Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs).
RESULTS: The review identified prominent IBD hot spots in Western São Paulo and Northwestern Paraná, characterized by shared urbanization (85%+), agro-industrial activity, and dietary transitions. These regions exhibit increased prevalence due to multifactorial mechanisms, such as genetic predisposition, Westernized diets, reduced environmental microbial exposure, and pesticide-related dysbiosis. However, diagnostic infrastructure disparities highlight underreporting in less developed regions, complicating nationwide comparisons.
CONCLUSION: Western São Paulo and Northwestern Paraná form a continuous IBD hot spot influenced by urbanization, agro-industrial practices, and environmental exposures. Addressing these challenges requires integrated public health policies focusing on environmental regulation, nutritional education, and improved diagnostic access. Future longitudinal studies should assess gene-environment interactions and further explore underrepresented regions to enhance IBD management and prevention strategies in Brazil.
papers.title_zh: 巴西發炎性腸道疾病之區域性與多因子型態分析：聖保羅西部與巴拉那熱點之系統性分析
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）是一種受遺傳、環境、免疫及行為因子交互作用影響的複雜疾病。全球IBD發生率上升，尤其在快速城市化國家如巴西，反映環境轉變對疾病型態之影響。診斷覆蓋率與環境因子的區域差異凸顯出IBD「熱點」，特別是聖保羅西部與巴拉那西北部，此兩地區具有相似的社經與環境特性。本研究系統性回顧這些流行病學型態，以填補研究缺口並支持公共衛生政策。
方法：依循PRISMA準則進行系統性文獻回顧，評估2006年至2026年間巴西IBD流行病學。資料來源包括PubMed、SciELO與LILACS，採用結合控制詞彙與自由文字詞的布林檢索策略。納入研究須提供IBD發生率、盛行率及相關風險因子之原始流行病學數據。透過Moran's I指數之地理空間分析辨識熱點，並輔以有向無環圖（DAGs）等整合概念模型支持。
結果：本回顧辨識出聖保羅西部與巴拉那西北部為顯著的IBD熱點，共同特徵為高城市化程度（85%以上）、農工業活動及飲食型態轉變。這些地區因多重機轉（包括遺傳易感性、西化飲食、環境微生物暴露減少、農藥相關腸道菌群失調）而盛行率增加。然而，診斷基礎設施差異導致較不發達地區存在低報現象，使全國性比較複雜化。

papers.title: Wearable Sweat Biosensors for Inflammatory Biomarkers (CRP, IL-6 and TNF-α): A Systematic Review of Analytical and Clinical Evidence
papers.authors: Alsharidah R, Anwer R, Abdelhamid M, Alanazi E, Alanazi F, Alanazi H
papers.abstract: Background: Wearable sweat biosensors have emerged as a promising non-invasive approach for monitoring inflammatory biomarkers, offering an alternative to repeated blood sampling. This systematic review evaluated the current evidence on the detection of C-reactive protein (CRP), interleukin-6 (IL-6), and tumor necrosis factor-α (TNF-α) in sweat for infection and inflammatory disease monitoring. Methods: Following PRISMA 2020 guidelines (PROSPERO: CRD420261371221), PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, Web of Science, IEEE Xplore, and Google Scholar were searched through April 2026. Human studies measuring CRP, IL-6, or TNF-α in sweat using wearable or biosensor-based platforms were included. Risk of bias and certainty of evidence were assessed using a modified Newcastle-Ottawa Scale/JBI checklist and GRADE. Results: Thirteen studies (2020-2025, 5-80 participants) were included. CRP showed the most consistent sweat-serum agreement (r = 0.844) and good diagnostic performance in one inflammatory bowel disease cohort (AUC = 0.845). TNF-α demonstrated the highest diagnostic accuracy in a single longitudinal study (AUC = 0.962), whereas IL-6 showed moderate sweat-serum correlations (R2 = 0.60-0.72) but limited diagnostic discrimination. IL-6 and TNF-α were more consistently detected in passively collected eccrine sweat, although IL-6 was also successfully measured following pilocarpine iontophoresis in one study. Most studies had moderate methodological quality. Conclusions: Sweat-based measurement of CRP, IL-6, and TNF-α is analytically feasible for non-invasive inflammatory biomarker monitoring. However, current evidence remains limited by small, heterogeneous studies, underscoring the need for standardized protocols and larger prospective clinical validation.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景：穿戴式汗液生物感測器已成為監測發炎標記物的一種有前景的非侵入性方法，可作為反覆採血的替代方案。本系統性回顧評估目前有關汗液中C反應蛋白（CRP）、白介素-6（IL-6）與腫瘤壞死因子-α（TNF-α）偵測用於感染及發炎疾病監測的證據。方法：依循PRISMA 2020指引（PROSPERO註冊號：CRD420261371221），檢索PubMed/MEDLINE、Scopus、Web of Science、IEEE Xplore及Google Scholar至2026年4月。納入使用穿戴式或生物感測器平台測量人類汗液中CRP、IL-6或TNF-α之研究。偏誤風險與證據確定性以修改版Newcastle-Ottawa Scale/JBI檢核表及GRADE評估。結果：共納入13篇研究（2020-2025年，樣本數5-80人）。CRP顯示最一致的汗液-血清相關性（r = 0.844），且在一項發炎性腸道疾病族群中有良好診斷表現（AUC = 0.845）。TNF-α在單一縱向研究中展現最高診斷準確度（AUC = 0.962），而IL-6顯示中等程度的汗液-血清相關性（R² = 0.60-0.72），但診斷區辨力有限。IL-6與TNF-α在被動收集的外分泌汗液中偵測較為一致，儘管IL-6在一項研究中亦於毛果芸香鹼離子導入法後成功測得。多數研究方法學品質為中等。結論：以汗液測量CRP、IL-6與TNF-α在分析上具可行性，可作為非侵入性發炎標記物監測方式。然而，目前證據仍受限於研究樣本小且異質性高，需要標準化流程及更大規模的前瞻性臨床驗證。

papers.title: Ceramide synthesis mediates colorectal cancer metastasis through a YAP-driven regenerative program
papers.authors: Goswami S, Zhang Q, Yildiz A, Das Adhikari U, Raghawan A, Bulliard M
papers.abstract: Mechanisms by which primary tumor cells acquire metastatic capability through metabolic and signaling adaptations are currently poorly understood. We demonstrate that tumor-intrinsic ceramide metabolism, amplified by dietary fat, initiates colorectal cancer metastasis. We observed that dietary fat exposure triggers a sustained increase in de novo ceramide biosynthesis, mediated by the dihydroceramide desaturase Degs1. Ceramide accumulation activates yes-associated protein (YAP) through protein phosphatase 2A (PP2A)-mediated dephosphorylation, promoting a durable shift toward a distinct YAP-driven regenerative (YAP-DR) program, marked by Basp1, that promotes metastasis. Selective elimination of Basp1high cancer cells prevented metastatic seeding. Degs1 loss reduced ceramide levels, YAP activity, YAP-DR signatures, and metastasis without affecting primary tumor growth, whereas blocking ceramide degradation enhanced YAP activity and metastasis. These findings identify ceramide-induced YAP signaling as a key mediator of metastatic initiation, operating independently of primary tumor expansion.
papers.title_zh: 神經醯胺合成透過YAP驅動的再生程式介導大腸直腸癌轉移
papers.abstract_zh: 腫瘤細胞如何透過代謝與訊號適應獲得轉移能力的機制目前仍不清楚。我們證明腫瘤內在的神經醯胺代謝，經飲食脂肪放大後，可啟動大腸直腸癌轉移。我們觀察到暴露於飲食脂肪會觸發由二氫神經醯胺去飽和酶Degs1所介導的、持續性de novo神經醯胺生合成增加。神經醯胺累積透過蛋白磷酸酶2A（PP2A）介導的去磷酸化作用活化YAP（yes-associated protein），促進轉變為一個獨特且持久的YAP驅動再生（YAP-DR）程式，此程式以Basp1為標記，可促進轉移。選擇性清除Basp1高表現的癌細胞可阻止轉移種植。Degs1缺失可降低神經醯胺水平、YAP活性、YAP-DR signature及轉移，但不影響原發腫瘤生長；反之，阻斷神經醯胺降解則增強YAP活性與轉移。這些發現指出神經醯胺誘導的YAP訊號是轉移啟動的關鍵介質，且其作用獨立於原發腫瘤擴張之外。

papers.title: Fibroblasts restrain gut inflammation by IGF1-dependent regulation of innate lymphocytes
papers.authors: Lin Q, Liu R, Wang Q, Kang L, Chen B, Lu Y
papers.abstract: Fibroblasts exhibit phenotypic and functional heterogeneity in chronic inflammatory diseases, but how these changes impact immune outcomes remains poorly understood. We identified that a fibroblast population expressing insulin-like growth factor 1 (IGF1) was reduced in patients with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD). Using mouse models of intestinal inflammation, we found cross-talk between IGF1-expressing fibroblasts and group 3 innate lymphoid cells (ILC3s). IGF1 stimulation limited the ability of ILC3s to produce C-X-C motif chemokine ligand 10 (CXCL10) and recruit plasmacytoid dendritic cells (pDCs) to restrain gut inflammation. We propose that this regulatory pathway is conserved in human ILC3s but may become impaired in IBD. Our results define that anti-inflammatory fibroblasts safeguard the gut through regulation of an innate lymphocyte-pDC axis.

papers.title: Comparative effectiveness of neoadjuvant therapy combined with stent placement versus stent alone in obstructive colorectal cancer: a multicenter retrospective analysis
papers.authors: Han Z, Zhang B, Liu S, Wu T, Qiao Q, He X
papers.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: The aim of this study was to evaluate the impact of self-expandable metal stents (SEMS) and neoadjuvant therapy (NAT) for obstructive colorectal cancer (CRC).
METHODS: This multicenter, retrospective study analyzed 154 patients with obstructive CRC from three centers between 2011 and 2025. Patients were allocated to either a NAT combined with SEMS group (n = 93) or a SEMS-alone group (n = 61). Short-term procedural outcomes, pathological tumor response, long-term survival, and the impact of the time interval from stenting to surgery were evaluated between groups and across two time periods (2011-2020 vs. 2021-2025).
RESULTS: Baseline characteristics were largely comparable between groups. The NAT group demonstrated significantly lower intraoperative stoma rates (8.6% vs. 29.0%, P = 0.031) and postoperative complication rates (8.6% vs. 29.0%, P = 0.031) in the 2011-2020, advantages that persisted in the 2021-2025. Pathological assessment revealed a superior tumor response in the 2021-2025, with 20.7% achieving TRG 0-1 and significantly higher rates of T and N downstaging (39.7% and 60.3%) compared to the 2011-2020. Although survival benefits were not significant in the 2011-2020 period, NAT may be associated with a significant improvement in overall survival (OS) in the 2021-2025 cohort (P = 0.013). Analysis of surgical timing identified an optimal interval of 14-21 days related to OS for the SEMS group, whereas for NAT patients, an interval exceeding 90 days was associated with worse disease-free survival (DFS).
CONCLUSION: SEMS-NAT for obstructive CRC may is an important factor for improved surgical quality and OS benefit in 2021-2025. This study provides crucial evidence for optimizing treatment strategy by recommending a surgery interval.
papers.title_zh: 新輔助治療合併支架置放與單純支架置放於阻塞性大腸直腸癌之比較療效：多中心回溯性分析
papers.abstract_zh: 目的：本研究旨在評估自體擴張型金屬支架（SEMS）合併新輔助治療（NAT）對於阻塞性大腸直腸癌（CRC）的影響。方法：這是一項多中心回顧性研究，分析了2011年至2025年間來自三個中心的154名阻塞性CRC患者。患者被分配至NAT合併SEMS組（n=93）或單純SEMS組（n=61）。評估兩組間以及兩個時間段（2011-2020年 vs. 2021-2025年）的短期手術結果、病理腫瘤反應、長期存活，以及支架置入至手術間隔時間的影響。結果：兩組基線特徵大致相當。在2011-2020年期間，NAT組顯示顯著較低的術中造口率（8.6% vs. 29.0%，P=0.031）及術後併發症率（8.6% vs. 29.0%，P=0.031），此優勢在2021-2025年期間持續存在。病理評估顯示，相較於2011-2020年期間，2021-2025年期間有較優的腫瘤反應，20.7%達到TRG 0-1，且T及N降期比率顯著較高（分別為39.7%及60.3%）。雖然2011-2020年期間存活益處未達顯著，但NAT可能與2021-2025年世代中整體存活（OS）的顯著改善有關（P=0.013）。手術時機分析發現，對SEMS組而言，與OS相關的最佳間隔為14-21天；而對NAT患者而言，間隔超過90天則與較差的無病存活（DFS）相關。結論：對阻塞性CRC而言，SEMS-NAT可能是2021-2025年期間改善手術品質及OS益處的重要因素。本研究提供了關鍵證據，透過建議手術間隔時間來優化治療策略。

papers.title: Vedolizumab vs TNF Antagonists and Long-Term Outcomes in Ulcerative Colitis
papers.authors: Singh S, Söderling J, Forss A, Rask-Andersen M, Halfvarson J, Everhov Å
papers.abstract:
IMPORTANCE: Tumor necrosis factor (TNF) antagonists and vedolizumab are the most commonly used advanced therapies for management of moderate-to-severe ulcerative colitis (UC). There are limited data evaluating long-term outcomes with a TNF antagonist-first vs vedolizumab-first treatment strategy.
OBJECTIVE: To compare long-term clinical outcomes among biologic-naive patients with UC initiating infliximab or adalimumab vs vedolizumab as first-line advanced therapy.
DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS: This Swedish nationwide population-based cohort study used linked health registers. Biologic-naive patients with UC who initiated infliximab, adalimumab, or vedolizumab between January 1, 2015, and June 30, 2021, were included and followed up until June 30, 2023, for a median of 4.3 to 5.4 years. Data analysis was conducted from April to September 2025.
EXPOSURES: Initiation of a TNF antagonist (ie, infliximab or adalimumab) or vedolizumab as first-line advanced therapy.
MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES: The primary outcome was the incidence rate of all-cause hospitalizations (including recurrent events). Secondary outcomes included incidence rates of colectomy, corticosteroid dispensations, advanced therapy switching, and proportion of quarters spent in corticosteroid-free disease stability (defined as no oral corticosteroid dispensation, no initiation of a new advanced therapy or immunomodulator, and no hospitalization or colectomy within a 3-month period). Groups were balanced using inverse probability of treatment weighting (IPTW) accounting for disease characteristics, health care utilization, comorbidities, and medication use.
RESULTS: Overall, 3263 patients (1393 infliximab, 1583 adalimumab, and 287 vedolizumab initiators) were included. After IPTW, there were with 1385 infliximab initiators (mean [SD] age, 38 [18] years; 43% female) compared with 320 vedolizumab initiators (mean [SD] age, 36 [19] years; 35% female) and 1575 adalimumab initiators (mean [SD] age, 41 [16] years; 48% female) compared with 318 vedolizumab initiators (mean [SD] age, 38 [19] years; 43% female). All-cause hospitalization did not differ significantly between infliximab and vedolizumab initiators (incidence rate ratio [IRR], 1.14 [95% CI, 0.91-1.43]); however, infliximab initiators spent a significantly lower proportion of time in corticosteroid-free disease stability over 5 years than vedolizumab initiators (60% vs 67% of quarters; risk ratio [RR], 0.88 [95% CI, 0.82-0.94]). Similarly, all-cause hospitalization did not differ significantly between adalimumab and vedolizumab initiators (IRR, 1.08 [95% CI, 0.86-1.35]), although adalimumab initiators had greater therapy switching (IRR, 1.21 [95% CI, 1.02-1.43]) and less time in corticosteroid-free stability (67% vs 70% of quarters; RR, 0.92 [95% CI, 0.87-0.98]) than vedolizumab initiators. Results were broadly consistent in 1:1 propensity score-matched sensitivity analyses.
CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE: In this cohort study of biologic-naive patients with UC initiating advanced therapy, the burden of hospitalization did not differ significantly between patients receiving vedolizumab and those receiving a TNF agonist; however, a vedolizumab-first strategy was associated with a greater proportion of time spent in corticosteroid-free disease stability over 5 years than a TNF antagonist-first strategy. These findings may inform first-line treatment selection in UC.

papers.title_zh: Vedolizumab 與 TNF 拮抗劑對潰瘍性大腸炎長期預後之比較
papers.abstract_zh: 重要性：TNF 拮抗劑與 vedolizumab 是治療中重度潰瘍性大腸炎（UC）最常使用的進階治療藥物。關於「先用 TNF 拮抗劑」與「先用 vedolizumab」兩種治療策略對長期預後之比較，現有資料有限。目的：比較未曾使用生物製劑的 UC 病人，以 infliximab 或 adalimumab 起始治療 vs 以 vedolizumab 作為第一線進階治療之長期臨床預後。設計、場域與參與者：本研究為瑞典全國性、以人群為基礎的世代研究，利用連結之健康登錄資料。納入2015年1月1日至2021年6月30日間，未曾使用生物製劑的UC病人起始infliximab、adalimumab或vedolizumab治療者，追蹤至2023年6月30日，中位追蹤時間4.3至5.4年。資料分析於2025年4月至9月進行。暴露：以TNF拮抗劑（infliximab或adalimumab）或vedolizumab作為第一線進階治療。主要預後與測量：主要結果為全因住院發生率（含重複事件）。次要結果包括腸切除術發生率、口服類固醇處方率、進階治療轉換率，以及處於「無類固醇疾病穩定期」（定義為3個月內無口服類固醇處方、無新啟動進階治療或免疫調節劑、無住院或腸切除）之季度比例。以逆機率治療加權（IPTW）平衡兩組疾病特徵、醫療利用、共病及用藥狀況。結果：共納入3263名病人（1393名infliximab、1583名adalimumab、287名vedolizumab起始者）。經IPTW後，infliximab組1385人（平均[SD]年齡38[18]歲；43%女性）對vedolizumab組320人（平均[SD]年齡36[19]歲；35%女性）；adalimumab組1575人（平均[SD]年齡41[16]歲；48%女性）對vedolizumab組318人（平均[SD]年齡38[19]歲；43%女性）。infliximab與vedolizumab起始者之全因住院無顯著差異（發生率比[IRR] 1.14 [95% CI, 0.91-1.43]）；然而，infliximab起始者於5年間處於無類固醇疾病穩定期的比例顯著低於vedolizumab起始者（60% vs 67%的季度；風險比[RR] 0.88 [95% CI, 0.82-0.94]）。同樣地，adalimumab與vedolizumab起始者之全因住院無顯著差異（IRR 1.08 [95% CI, 0.86-1.35]），但adalimumab起始者治療轉換率較高（IRR 1.21 [95% CI, 1.02-1.43]），且無類固醇穩定期比例較低（67% vs 70%的季度；RR 0.92 [95% CI, 0.87-0.98]）。以1:1傾向分數配對進行敏感性分析，結果大致一致。結論與相關性：在此針對未曾使用生物製劑之UC病人起始進階治療的世代研究中，接受vedolizumab與接受TNF拮抗劑者的住院負擔並無顯著差異；然而，以vedolizumab為第一線策略者，5年間處於無類固醇疾病穩定期的比例較以TNF拮抗劑為第一線策略者更高。此發現可作為UC第一線治療選擇之參考。

papers.title: Nutrition Care Practices in Colorectal Cancer: A National Survey of Patients, Caregivers, and Healthcare Professionals in Canada
papers.authors: Karry I, Chung S, Stein B, Graifer O, Ford K, Jagoe R
papers.abstract: Nutrition is an essential component of colorectal cancer (CRC) care, influencing treatment tolerance, functional status, and quality of life, yet it remains inconsistently integrated into practice. This study examined experiences with nutrition management and gaps in nutrition care among patients with CRC, caregivers, and healthcare professionals across Canada through a multi-center, cross-sectional survey conducted from July 2025 to February 2026. A total of 243 participants completed the survey, including 121 patients, 45 caregivers, and 77 healthcare professionals. Among patients, 51.2% reported that nutritional status was discussed or assessed during treatment, while 24.0% reported it was never discussed. More than half of patients (55.4%) said they did not receive adequate information regarding weight loss during treatment. Caregivers described substantial nutrition impact symptoms and identified a need for clearer guidance, emotional support, and improved access to dietitians. Healthcare professionals rated nutrition care as highly important yet reported barriers to effective delivery, including limited staffing, lack of standardized screening, and reactive care processes. Across groups, respondents emphasized the importance of timely, personalized, and culturally relevant nutrition care. Overall, nutrition remains insufficiently embedded in CRC care, highlighting the need for routine screening, standardized referral pathways, earlier intervention, and integrated patient-centered nutrition care models to improve CRC care.

papers.abstract_zh: 營養是大腸直腸癌（CRC）照護中不可或缺的一環，影響治療耐受性、功能狀態與生活品質，但目前臨床實務中仍未能一致整合營養照護。本研究透過2025年7月至2026年2月於加拿大進行的多中心橫斷面調查，探討CRC病人、照顧者與醫療專業人員在營養管理上的經驗與照護缺口。共243名參與者完成問卷，包括121名病人、45名照顧者與77名醫療專業人員。在病人中，51.2%表示治療期間有討論或評估過營養狀況，24.0%表示從未被討論過。超過半數病人（55.4%）表示在治療期間未獲得充分的體重減輕相關資訊。照顧者描述了顯著的營養相關症狀衝擊，並指出需要更清楚的指引、情緒支持及更便於取得的營養師資源。醫療專業人員將營養照護評為高度重要，但也回報執行上的障礙，包括人力有限、缺乏標準化篩檢工具，以及被動式照護流程。各群體皆強調及時、個人化及符合文化需求的營養照護之重要性。整體而言，營養照護在CRC照護中仍未被充分整合，突顯需要常規篩檢、標準化轉介路徑、更早期介入，以及整合式以病人為中心的營養照護模式，以改善CRC照護品質。

papers.title: Evaluating sonographic response and remission in inflammatory bowel disease: aligning intestinal ultrasound assessment with STRIDE-II timelines
papers.authors: Srinivasan A, Sagami S, Nguyen A, Smith R, Vasudevan A, Taylor S
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND AND AIMS: The diagnostic accuracy of intestinal ultrasound (IUS) is established; however, guidance on the timing and interpretation of sonographic response and remission in inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) remains limited. This review synthesizes current evidence to define expected response and remission kinetics in Crohn's disease (CD) and ulcerative colitis (UC) across STRIDE-II aligned reassessment timepoints.
METHODS: A structured narrative review was undertaken of studies published up to August 31, 2025 evaluating longitudinal IUS changes following initiation of medical therapy in patients with CD and UC. Outcomes were synthesized across early (<3 months), intermediate (3-6 months), and longer-term (6-12 months) reassessment intervals aligned with STRIDE-II timelines.
RESULTS: In CD, sonographic response was reported in approximately 51%-66% of patients by 12 weeks, while remission was reported in 14%-37%. At 3-6 months, response was reported in approximately 36%-38%, while remission was reported in 12%-38%. Longer-term response and remission were reported in approximately 36%-57% and 24%-42%, respectively, at 48-56 weeks. In UC, response was reported in 57%-77% and remission in 45%-64% by weeks 8-12 in selected cohorts. However, traditional IUS response and remission estimates beyond this early treatment phase remain limited in UC. Direct comparisons between studies was limited by heterogeneity in outcome definitions, reassessment timepoints, therapy class, and disease characteristics.
CONCLUSION: IUS is a practical, non-invasive tool for monitoring therapeutic response in IBD. The optimal timing of reassessment is likely to vary according to therapy-specific time to response, IBD subtype, disease phenotype, and bowel segment. Standardization of definitions and reassessment timelines remain central to integrating IUS into treat-to-target models of IBD care.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景與目的：腸道超音波（IUS）之診斷準確性已獲確立；然而，關於發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）中超音波反應與緩解之評估時機與判讀指引仍有限。本綜述整合現有證據，以定義克隆氏症（CD）與潰瘍性大腸炎（UC）在對齊STRIDE-II重新評估時間點下之預期反應與緩解動態。方法：針對2025年8月31日前發表、評估CD與UC患者接受藥物治療後IUS縱向變化之研究，進行結構化敘事性綜述。結果依早期（<3個月）、中期（3-6個月）、長期（6-12個月）重新評估區間（與STRIDE-II時間表對齊）進行整合。結果：在CD中，於第12週時約51%-66%患者報告有超音波反應，緩解則為14%-37%。於3-6個月時，反應約為36%-38%，緩解為12%-38%。長期（第48-56週）反應與緩解分別約為36%-57%及24%-42%。在UC中，於第8-12週時，選定世代中反應為57%-77%，緩解為45%-64%。然而，超過此早期治療階段後，UC傳統IUS反應與緩解之估計值仍有限。研究間之直接比較因結果定義、重新評估時間點、治療藥物類別及疾病特徵之異質性而受限。結論：IUS是監測IBD治療反應之實用、非侵入性工具。最佳重新評估時機可能依治療藥物特異性反應時間、IBD亞型、疾病表型及腸段而異。定義與重新評估時間表之標準化，對於將IUS整合入IBD治療達標模式仍屬核心課題。

papers.title: Seaweed sulfated polysaccharides regulate the gut microbiota-mucosal barrier-innate immunity axis: structural heterogeneity, immunological evidence, and translational prospects
papers.authors: Liu W, Zhang M, Huang J, Liu S, Chen R, Li Y
papers.abstract: Seaweed sulfated polysaccharides, fucoidan, carrageenan, ulvan, and porphyran, are structurally diverse marine glycans that modulate the gut microbiota, mucosal barrier, and innate immunity, yet the literature remains fragmented across classes, models, and processing histories. This review synthesizes evidence on their structure-function relationships, focusing on microbial enzymatic accessibility, selective fermentation, metabolite remodeling, barrier regulation, and immune signaling, while also assessing translational barriers. A systematic literature search prioritized mechanistic studies, structural analyses, animal models, human trials, and high-quality reviews. Our analysis reveals that porphyran provides the clearest microbiota-barrier coupling, fucoidan and carrageenan give the richest, but most heterogeneous, immune readouts, and ulvan is an emerging class with growing intestinal evidence. Molecular weight, sulfation pattern, and degradation history consistently shape microbial utilization and downstream effects across all classes. Disease contexts with the strongest support include inflammatory bowel disease, constipation, barrier injury, and infection-driven intestinal inflammation. Time-dependent immune shifts have been reported, but durable epigenetic memory remains unproven, and extra-intestinal evidence through gut-liver and gut-brain axes is still preliminary. We conclude that these polysaccharides are best understood as structurally defined substrates that bridge the microbiota, barrier, and immunity; future progress toward clinical translation will depend on stricter standardization, integrated mechanistic designs, and robust human data.

papers.abstract_zh: 海藻硫酸化多醣，包括褐藻多醣（fucoidan）、卡拉膠（carrageenan）、綠藻多醣（ulvan）與紫菜多醣（porphyran），是結構多樣的海洋醣類，可調節腸道菌群、黏膜屏障與先天免疫，但相關文獻在不同分類、模型與加工歷史間仍呈碎片化狀態。本綜述整合了這些多醣結構-功能關係的證據，聚焦於微生物酶可及性、選擇性發酵、代謝物重塑、屏障調節與免疫訊號傳導，同時評估轉譯障礙。系統性文獻搜尋優先納入機制研究、結構分析、動物模型、人體試驗及高品質綜述。分析顯示，紫菜多醣提供最明確的菌群-屏障耦合關係，褐藻多醣與卡拉膠提供最豐富但最異質的免疫讀數，而綠藻多醣是新興類別，腸道證據正逐漸增加。分子量、硫酸化模式與降解歷史一致地影響所有類別多醣的微生物利用與下游效應。支持證據最強的疾病情境包括發炎性腸道疾病、便秘、屏障損傷及感染引起的腸道炎症。已有時間依賴性免疫變化的報告，但持久的表觀遺傳記憶尚未被證實，經腸-肝軸與腸-腦軸的腸外證據仍屬初步階段。我們認為，這些多醣最好被理解為連結菌群、屏障與免疫的結構明確基質；未來邁向臨床轉譯的進展將取決於更嚴謹的標準化、整合性機制設計與可靠的人體數據。

papers.title: Gut microbiota-innate immune crosstalk in the initiation and progression of CRC: mechanisms and therapeutic potential
papers.authors: Lin J, Lin H, Zhang Z, Wang H
papers.abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) is a common malignancy of the digestive system, and its initiation and progression are associated with multiple factors, including genetic alterations, environmental exposures, changes in the gut microbiota, and disruption of immune homeostasis. In recent years, evidence from human observational studies, animal models, and in vitro experiments has shown that the gut microbiota can influence Toll-like receptor and NOD-like receptor signaling, NF-κB activation, the NLRP3 inflammasome, and immunometabolic pathways through multiple mechanisms, including microbial structural components, metabolic signals, virulence factors, and outer membrane vesicles. These effects are associated with functional remodeling of innate immune components such as macrophages, dendritic cells, neutrophils, and natural killer (NK) cells. Conversely, the innate immune system can reshape microbial composition, spatial distribution, and metabolic characteristics through antimicrobial effector molecules, maintenance of the mucosal barrier, release of inflammatory mediators, and phagocytic clearance, indicating a bidirectional regulatory relationship between the gut microbiota and innate immunity. Current evidence suggests that microbiota-innate immune interactions are associated, to varying degrees, with CRC-related pathological processes, including alterations in immune surveillance and the myeloid microenvironment, barrier dysfunction, low-grade inflammation, remodeling of the tumor microenvironment, epithelial-mesenchymal transition-related phenotypes, and immune evasion. Notably, colibactin-associated mutational signatures have been directly demonstrated in the genomes of human CRC tumors, representing one of the relatively rare forms of high-strength mechanistic evidence in microbiota-CRC research. Beyond such a limited number of well-supported mechanisms, however, many specific microbiota-immune interactions and their roles at different pathological stages remain based primarily on animal models, in vitro experiments, or integrative inference, while longitudinal causal evidence in humans remains generally limited. This review focuses on the bidirectional interactions between the gut microbiota and innate immunity in CRC, systematically summarizing their molecular mechanisms, associated pathological processes, and advances in microbiota-targeted interventions, with particular emphasis on distinguishing among different types of evidence, experimental contexts, and levels of causal certainty. In doing so, we aim to provide a more cautious theoretical basis for mechanistic research on the microbiota-immune axis and for the development of precision intervention strategies in CRC.

papers.abstract_zh: 大腸直腸癌（CRC）是常見的消化道惡性腫瘤，其起始與進展與多種因子相關，包括基因變異、環境暴露、腸道菌群改變，以及免疫homeostasis失調。近年來，來自人類觀察性研究、動物模型與體外實驗的證據顯示，腸道菌群可透過多種機制，包括微生物結構成分、代謝訊號、毒力因子與外膜囊泡，影響Toll-like receptor與NOD-like receptor訊號傳遞、NF-κB活化、NLRP3發炎小體，以及免疫代謝路徑。這些效應與巨噬細胞、樹突細胞、嗜中性球及自然殺手（NK）細胞等先天性免疫成分的功能重塑相關。相反地，先天性免疫系統也可透過抗菌效應分子、黏膜屏障維持、發炎介質釋放及吞噬清除作用，重塑微生物組成、空間分布與代謝特徵，顯示腸道菌群與先天性免疫之間存在雙向調控關係。目前證據顯示，菌群與先天性免疫的交互作用在不同程度上與CRC相關病理過程有關，包括免疫監視與骨髓性微環境的改變、屏障功能障礙、低度發炎、腫瘤微環境重塑、上皮間質轉化相關表型，以及免疫逃逸。值得注意的是，colibactin相關突變特徵已直接在人類CRC腫瘤基因組中被證實，代表菌群-CRC研究中較少見的高強度機制證據之一。除了少數獲得充分支持的機制外，許多特定的菌群-免疫交互作用及其在不同病理階段的角色，仍主要基於動物模型、體外實驗或整合性推論，人體中的縱向因果證據普遍仍屬有限。本綜述聚焦於CRC中腸道菌群與先天性免疫之間的雙向交互作用，系統性總結其分子機制、相關病理過程，以及以菌群為靶點的介入進展，並特別強調區分不同類型的證據、實驗情境與因果確定性層級。藉此，我們希望為菌群-免疫軸的機制研究，以及CRC精準介入策略的開發，提供更謹慎的理論基礎。

papers.title: Villous Architecture in Colorectal Adenomas: Molecular Pathogenesis, Epithelial Plasticity, and Malignant Risk
papers.authors: Hu Z, Vanoverbeke T, Yin K, Jans A, Arpaia C, Bisschops R
papers.abstract: Villous morphology is routinely used to stratify risk in conventional colorectal adenomas, yet it remains largely interpreted as a visual histological descriptor. This review proposes a different view: villous architecture is a graded, spatially organized epithelial state that links premalignant tissue remodeling to malignant potential. Across histological, molecular, and microenvironmental studies, villous-containing adenomas show convergent features of WNT-driven stem-like expansion, YAP-associated plasticity, fetal-regenerative or fetal-metaplastic transcriptional programs, mucin remodeling, stromal activation, immune attenuation, and genomic instability. These features appear to arise through interacting routes rather than through a single deterministic mutation. This framework helps explain why villous proportion predicts risk imperfectly: it captures a composite biological state but does not resolve its individual components. Quantitative morphometry, spatial transcriptomics, multiplex imaging, and region-resolved genomics could therefore move villous architecture from an observer-dependent category to a continuous, biologically interpretable marker of early malignant transition. Such a shift may improve adenoma classification, refine surveillance strategies, and identify high-risk lesions before conventional thresholds for advanced histology are reached.
papers.title_zh: 大腸直腸腺瘤中的絨毛狀結構：分子致病機轉、上皮可塑性與惡性風險
papers.abstract_zh: 絨毛型態常規用於傳統大腸直腸腺瘤的風險分層，但目前仍多被視為一種視覺化的組織學描述指標。本篇綜述提出不同觀點：絨毛結構是一種分級、具空間組織性的上皮狀態，連結癌前組織重塑與惡性潛能。綜合組織學、分子與微環境研究，含絨毛成分的腺瘤呈現出趨同的特徵，包括WNT驅動的幹細胞樣擴增、YAP相關的可塑性、胎兒型再生或胎兒型化生轉錄程序、黏液重塑、間質活化、免疫減弱，以及基因組不穩定性。這些特徵似乎透過交互作用的多重途徑產生，而非單一決定性突變所致。此框架有助於解釋為何絨毛比例對風險的預測並不完美：它捕捉的是一種複合性生物狀態，但無法解析其個別組成成分。因此，定量形態計量學、空間轉錄體學、多重免疫染色影像，以及區域解析基因組學，可能有助於將絨毛結構從一個依賴觀察者判讀的分類，轉變為一個連續性、具生物學可解釋性的早期惡性轉化標記。這樣的轉變可能改善腺瘤分類、精進監測策略，並在達到傳統進階組織學閾值之前，辨識出高風險病灶。

papers.title: Beyond robotic platforms: artificial intelligence and the emergence of intelligent surgical ecosystems in colorectal surgery
papers.abstract: Robotic surgery has substantially advanced minimally invasive colorectal surgery through improvements in dexterity, visualization, and ergonomics. However, contemporary robotic platforms remain fundamentally mechanical systems that rely almost entirely on surgeons for perception, clinical judgment, and intraoperative decision-making. As colorectal surgery becomes increasingly complex and the surgical population grows older and frailer, further progress is unlikely to depend on hardware innovation alone. This narrative review and conceptual synthesis was informed by a purposive, non-systematic search of PubMed, Embase, and Scopus for literature relevant to artificial intelligence (AI) and robotic colorectal surgery. The review focuses on the evolution of robotic platforms, current and emerging AI applications across the colorectal surgical pathway, and the proposed conceptual framework of the Intelligent Surgical Ecosystem. Recent advances in computer vision, foundation models, multimodal AI, and surgical data science are creating opportunities to integrate heterogeneous clinical information to support patient selection, operative planning, context-aware intraoperative assistance, and postoperative management. However, the clinical maturity of these applications varies substantially, with many technologies remaining at developmental or proof-of-concept stages. The convergence of robotics, AI, and digital health technologies provides the conceptual foundation for Intelligent Surgical Ecosystems, in which multimodal data may ultimately be integrated across the perioperative continuum to support precision and patient-centered colorectal surgical care. The future of colorectal surgery lies not in autonomous machines, but in intelligent systems that integrate multimodal data and support governed learning across the surgical pathway to augment human expertise and enable safer, more personalized, and precision-based surgical care.

papers.abstract_zh: 機器手臂手術已透過提升靈巧度、視覺化與人體工學，大幅推進微創大腸直腸手術之發展。然而，當代機器手臂平台本質上仍是機械系統，幾乎完全依賴外科醫師進行知覺判斷、臨床決策與術中決策。隨著大腸直腸手術日益複雜、手術族群趨於高齡與衰弱，未來的進展不太可能只依靠硬體創新。本篇敘事性綜述與概念綜合，透過對PubMed、Embase與Scopus進行目的性、非系統性文獻檢索，聚焦於人工智慧（AI）與機器手臂大腸直腸手術相關文獻。本文回顧機器手臂平台的演進、目前及新興AI於大腸直腸手術路徑各階段之應用，並提出「智慧手術生態系統」之概念框架。電腦視覺、基礎模型、多模態AI與手術資料科學之最新進展，正創造整合異質性臨床資訊之機會，以支持病人篩選、手術規劃、情境感知式術中輔助及術後照護。然而，這些應用的臨床成熟度差異甚大，許多技術仍處於開發或概念驗證階段。機器人技術、AI與數位健康技術之匯流，為「智慧手術生態系統」提供概念基礎，未來多模態資料可望於整個圍手術期整合，以支持精準、以病人為中心的大腸直腸手術照護。大腸直腸手術的未來並非全自動化機器，而是能整合多模態資料、並在整個手術路徑中支持受控學習之智慧系統，以增強人類專業能力，實現更安全、更個人化、更精準的手術照護。

papers.title: KRAS in Colorectal Cancer: Tumorigenesis, Surgical Implications and Evolving Treatment Target
papers.authors: Iftikhar S, Xiao A, Jin Z, Aly E
papers.abstract:
PURPOSE: This review aims to provide an updated overview of Kirsten rat sarcoma viral oncogene homologue (KRAS) mutations in colorectal carcinoma (CRC), focusing on their role in tumorigenesis, prognostic implications, and recent advances in targeted therapy.
MAJOR FINDINGS: KRAS mutations occur in approximately 40% of colorectal cancers and play a central role in tumour initiation and progression through constitutive activation of MAPK pathways. Clinically, KRAS mutations are well established as predictors of resistance to anti-EGFR therapy. Increasing evidence also supports their role as prognostic biomarkers, with KRAS-mutant tumours associated with increased recurrence risk and reduced survival, including in patients undergoing hepatic metastasectomy. Therapeutically, recent advances, most notably KRAS G12C inhibitors and combination strategies targeting upstream or parallel pathways, have expanded treatment options, although efficacy varies across KRAS mutation subtypes.
CONCLUSIONS: KRAS mutations have important implications for the behaviour, prognosis, and management of colorectal cancer. Integrating KRAS mutational status into clinical decision-making may enable more personalised prognostication and treatment strategies. Continued research is required to broaden effective targeted therapies for the diverse spectrum of KRAS-mutant disease.

papers.title: The role of IRF5 as an immune regulator
papers.authors: Menocal L, Huang A, Rachelkar A, Barnes B
papers.abstract: Interferon regulatory factor 5 (IRF5) is a transcription factor at the nexus of immune regulation, inflammation, and autoimmune disease. Studies have shown that dysregulation of IRF5 is strongly implicated in the pathogenesis of autoimmune diseases including systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE), rheumatoid arthritis (RA), and inflammatory bowel disease. While originally described as a regulator downstream of Toll-like receptor (TLR)-MyD88 signaling in myeloid cells, further studies demonstrate a more complex role for IRF5 in mediating adaptive immune responses as well. In this review, we provide a summary of the role of IRF5 across the major immune cell populations in which it is expressed. We discuss the mechanistic basis of IRF5 function in each population, highlight shared themes, and examine the evidence supporting IRF5 as a promising therapeutic target whose inhibition may selectively dampen pathological inflammation while preserving protective immunity. We thus provide an overview of how IRF5 bridges both innate and adaptive immune responses.

papers.abstract_zh: 干擾素調節因子5（IRF5）是位於免疫調節、發炎與自體免疫疾病交會處的轉錄因子。研究顯示IRF5的失調與多種自體免疫疾病的致病機轉密切相關，包括全身性紅斑性狼瘡（SLE）、類風濕性關節炎（RA）及發炎性腸道疾病。雖然IRF5最初被描述為髓系細胞中Toll樣受體（TLR）-MyD88訊息傳遞下游的調節因子，但進一步研究顯示其在調節適應性免疫反應方面也扮演更複雜的角色。在本篇綜述中，我們總結了IRF5在其表現之各主要免疫細胞族群中的角色。我們討論IRF5在每個細胞族群中功能的機制基礎，強調共通主題，並檢視支持IRF5作為具潛力治療標的之證據——抑制IRF5可能選擇性抑制病理性發炎，同時保留保護性免疫功能。因此，本文提供了IRF5如何連結先天性與適應性免疫反應的整體概觀。

papers.title: Spondyloarthropathies
papers.authors: Kim A, Van Weezep J, Silva T
papers.abstract: Spondyloarthropathies are a group of inflammatory syndromes that includes ankylosing spondylitis, reactive arthritis, inflammatory bowel disease-associated arthritis, psoriatic arthritis, and undifferentiated spondyloarthropathy. Each subtype can present with axial and peripheral symptoms. These syndromes share genetic predisposition and clinical findings, including inflammatory back pain, peripheral arthritis, dactylitis, and enthesitis. Additional clinical features include ocular disease, mucocutaneous lesions, and inflammatory bowel disease. Diagnosis is made primarily through history and physical examination findings, but radiography and testing for the HLA-B27 gene are also performed. Treatment depends on the specific subtype and typically involves a multimodal approach, including nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs, physical therapy, and biologic therapy (eg, tumor necrosis factor inhibitors). The goal of the family physician is to recognize early signs and symptoms and initiate appropriate treatment to optimize quality of life and minimize disease progression.
papers.abstract_zh: 脊椎關節病是一組發炎性症候群，包括僵直性脊椎炎、反應性關節炎、發炎性腸道疾病相關關節炎、乾癬性關節炎，以及未分類脊椎關節病。每個亞型皆可表現出中軸型與周邊型症狀。這些症候群具有共同的基因傾向與臨床表現，包括發炎性背痛、周邊關節炎、指炎（dactylitis）與附著點炎（enthesitis）。其他臨床特徵包括眼部疾病、皮膚黏膜病灶，以及發炎性腸道疾病。診斷主要依靠病史與身體檢查發現，但也會進行X光檢查與HLA-B27基因檢測。治療則依特定亞型而異，通常採取多模式治療方式，包括非類固醇消炎止痛藥、物理治療，以及生物製劑治療（例如腫瘤壞死因子抑制劑）。家庭醫師的目標是辨識早期徵象與症狀，並啟動適當治療，以優化生活品質並減緩疾病進展。
